blocker.exact_error: NOT_FOUND: No available engine for backend: GPU_ARTISAN. Preferred engine types: [kAdvancedLegacyTfLite, kLegacyTfLite]. Available (registered) engine types: [kAdvancedLiteRTCompiledModel]
blocker.mechanism: EngineSettings::CreateDefault inspected the pinned artifact, found an Artisan text-decoder section, and changed the requested GPU backend to GPU_ARTISAN. The pinned v0.16.1 open-source Android runner links only engine_advanced_impl, which registers kAdvancedLiteRTCompiledModel. EngineFactory requires one of the legacy TFLite engine types for GPU_ARTISAN, but neither is registered in this build.
blocker.reason_no_fallback_claim: The runner failed closed before inference; no output or timing was relabeled as GPU.
blocker.stage: EngineFactory::CreateDefault before prompt inventory or first request

claim: No Android GPU performance claim. The pinned GPU artifact did not create an Engine and no logical request ran.
decision_needed: Authorize amending the GPU arm to use the 2,588,147,712-byte generic gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm artifact with Backend::GPU. The pinned deployment model card reports the Android GPU model size as 2,583 MB, matching that generic artifact rather than the 2,008 MB dedicated GPU artifact.
Or provide/authorize a LiteRT-LM Android runtime route that registers kAdvancedLegacyTfLite or kLegacyTfLite for this pinned Artisan GPU artifact.
limitations: The dedicated GPU artifact was verified by hash and reached official runtime detection, but no provider was bound and no request ran.
The model-card artifact interpretation is a route-selection question, not permission to silently replace the locked artifact.

local_viability_gate.host_build_missing_reason: The pinned Bazel host configuration forces CC=clang/CXX=clang++, but this host exposes gcc/g++ and no clang. This does not alter the Android runtime blocker, which was captured with the successfully built arm64 binary on the authorized phone.
